solver: FEM: Morley nonconforming Kirchhoff plate triangle (scikit-fem 12.0.2) on an unstructured mesh (Shewchuk Triangle, min angle 30 deg, max area 2e-5, ~60k triangles); generalized eigenproblem via ARPACK shift-invert; free edges are natural BCs of the weak form, clamped edges by eliminating deflection + normal-slope DOFs. Solver validated against the exact Bessel solution of the free disc (nu=0.33): max lambda2 error 0.05% over the first 16 elastic modes.
notes: unit size: body length = 1 (y axis); lower bout width 0.736. geometry: classical-guitar top outline (lower+upper bout, waist), PCHIP through stated control points, mirror-symmetric; polygon included in file.
